item.title: Transformer Industry Briefing — 21 August 2026
item.description: India commissions 35,670 MVA of ≥220 kV transformation capacity in Apr–Jul FY27 — 66% of plan in four months, PGCIL 16,000 MVA of it · Atlanta Electricals takes a Rs 193.92 cr APTRANSCO letter of intent for twelve 160 MVA, 220/132 kV auto-transformers · Ukrenergo auctions six war-damaged transformers and autotransformers, 785 MVA combined, from $239,700 in Odesa on 7 Sep · TEİAŞ contracts the Antalya GIS and Side GIS trafo merkezi completion works to GES Genel Elektrik at ₺547,202,038

item.title: Transformer Industry Briefing — 19 August 2026
item.description: Oman signs ten agreements worth RO15m ($39m) to localise transformer-component manufacturing — seven new factories for eight components plus two new production lines, with Voltamp Energy under the APSR · SPPC extends the Round-7 NREP bid deadlines — four solar IPPs to 13 Sep and two wind IPPs to 14 Sep, 5,300 MW in total · State Grid’s third 2026 UHV equipment batch lands at CNY 10.872bn, taking the year to date to CNY 29.261bn — already past all of 2025 · Korea’s top three power-equipment makers reach a combined ₩36.73tn ($25.7bn) order backlog

item.title: Transformer Industry Briefing — 18 August 2026
item.description: Saudi Energy awards the Expo 2030 Riyadh power package — one 380/132 kV BSP plus three 132/13.8 kV primary substations to Al-Babtain, Haif, Alfanar and TDP · KSA approves a new Government Tenders & Procurement Law — 20% variation cap, direct-procurement ceiling up 10× to SR1m · State Grid’s first four 2026 UHV tenders total CNY 29.26bn, converter transformers CNY 5.13bn across nine packages · First hydrogen flows Lingen→Marl on the 120 km GET H2 Nukleus pipeline · Copper $14,545/t and aluminium $3,248/t (14 Aug cash) — Cu/Al 4.478

item.title: Transformer Industry Briefing — 16 August 2026
item.description: Hitachi Energy signs the Erbil three-substation deal for the Kurdistan Region (northern Iraq) · Hitachi Energy Italy wins five e-distribuzione HV/MV transformer contracts worth €181.76m · Egypt EETC signs the Girga upgrade — 33 kV (3×20 MVA) rebuilt to 66 kV (3×40 MVA), turnkey · Copper $14,545/t and aluminium $3,248/t (14 Aug cash) — Cu/Al 4.478, the widest ratio of 2026
